resources.string: Send a message to start the conversation
Requires a Hugging Face token: enter it in Settings and accept the model license on the Hugging Face website.
Pick a file from phone storage
No model has been downloaded or added yet.
The file \"%1$s\" will be removed from this phone.
Fast and light; fits most phones. Acceptable for simple Persian.
Same Gemma 3 1B with a larger context (up to 4096 tokens). Raise \"Max tokens\" in Settings.
Multilingual, no token needed. Larger and uses more RAM; test its Persian quality yourself.
The conversation memory was full; older parts were dropped to continue.
The previous model load failed or the app was closed, so auto-load was skipped. The model may be too large for this phone\'s RAM.
If the processor is set to GPU, try CPU in Settings.
The message is too long for the model memory. Shorten it or raise \"Max tokens\" in Settings.
The selected file could not be read.
Invalid address; it must start with https://
Access denied (error %1$d). Gated models such as Gemma need a Hugging Face token: enter it in Settings and accept the model license on the website.
The downloaded file size does not match the announced size; please download again.
The token is stored only on this phone, in the app\'s private storage.
System prompt (e.g. Answer briefly in Persian)
Changing \"Max tokens\" or \"Processor\" reloads the model when you leave this screen. Max tokens must not exceed the model capacity (ekv); ekv1280 models allow up to 1280.
GPU is unstable on some phones; if the model fails to load, choose CPU.
\"Auto\" detects the template from the file name (Gemma / Qwen). If replies look odd, pick the right template manually.
